module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);
  assign p1y = ~((p1a & p1b) & (p1c & p1d));
  assign p2y = ~((p2a & p2b) & (p2c & p2d));
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  input p1e,
  input p1f,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  assign p2y = (p2d & p2c) | (p2b & p2a);
  assign p1y = (p1e & p1f) | (~(p1d & p1e)) | (~(p1a & p1b) & p1c);

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] code,
  output reg [3:0] out,
  output reg valid
);

  always @(*) begin
    case (code)
      8'h45: begin out = 4'h0; valid = 1; end
      8'h16: begin out = 4'h1; valid = 1; end
      8'h1E: begin out = 4'h2; valid = 1; end
      8'h26: begin out = 4'h3; valid = 1; end
      8'h25: begin out = 4'h4; valid = 1; end
      8'h2E: begin out = 4'h5; valid = 1; end
      8'h36: begin out = 4'h6; valid = 1; end
      8'h3D: begin out = 4'h7; valid = 1; end
      8'h3E: begin out = 4'h8; valid = 1; end
      8'h46: begin out = 4'h9; valid = 1; end
      default: begin out = 4'h0; valid = 0; end
    endcase
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] a,
  input [3:0] b,
  input [3:0] c,
  input [3:0] d,
  input [3:0] e,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  integer i;
  
  always @(*) begin
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin
      q[i] = (a[i] & b[i] & c[i]) |
             (a[i] & b[i] & d[i]) |
             (a[i] & b[i] & e[i]) |
             (a[i] & c[i] & d[i]) |
             (a[i] & c[i] & e[i]) |
             (a[i] & d[i] & e[i]) |
             (b[i] & c[i] & d[i]) |
             (b[i] & c[i] & e[i]) |
             (b[i] & d[i] & e[i]) |
             (c[i] & d[i] & e[i]);
    end
  end

endmodule
